crew.overview: Selma, a Czech immigrant on the verge of blindness, struggles to make ends meet for herself and her son, who has inherited the same genetic disorder and will suffer the same fate without an expensive operation. When life gets too difficult, Selma learns to cope through her love of musicals, dreaming up little numbers to the rhythmic beats of her surroundings.
crew.title: Dancer in the Dark

crew.original_title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
crew.overview: Disgraced journalist Mikael Blomkvist investigates the disappearance of a weary patriarch's niece from 40 years ago. He is aided by the pierced, tattooed, punk computer hacker named Lisbeth Salander. As they work together in the investigation, Blomkvist and Salander uncover immense corruption beyond anything they have ever imagined.
crew.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo

crew.overview: Two teenage girls in small-town Sweden. Elin is beautiful, popular, and bored with life. Agnes is friendless, sad, and secretly in love with Elin.
crew.title: Show Me Love

crew.overview: A woman on the run from the mob is reluctantly accepted in a small Colorado community in exchange for labor, but when a search visits the town, she learns that their support has a price.
crew.title: Dogville

crew.overview: In a struggling post-Soviet community, Lilya a teenage girl is abandoned when her mother moves to the United States with her boyfriend. Facing neglect and poverty, she meets Andrei, who offers her a job in Sweden, giving her hope for a better life — and a journey that will change everything.
crew.title: Lilya 4-ever

details.biography:
Carl Malte Julius Forssell, born December 16, 1959, in Stockholm, is a Swedish film producer and production manager.

Forssell studied at the Dramatic Institute's production management line 1986–1989. In 2010, he was awarded a Guldbagge in the category Special Efforts with the motivation "For having extremely skilfully kept the filming together in three continents of the film Mammut".
details.name: Malte Forssell
